description: Estimate how many people a Pinterest ad group’s targeting can reach per month, before spending. Pass targetingSpec (e.g. {"GEO":["US"],"AGE_BUCKET":["25-34"]}), keywords and/or productGroupIds. A range from Pinterest’s historical data, not a promise. Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

matchType.description: default BROAD; a campaign takes only the _NEGATIVE types

value.description: the search words, up to 120 characters

targetingSpec.description: Pinterest targeting object, the same one an ad group takes

name: pinterest_ads_audience_size
title: Pinterest audience size
